summary: Implemented only the RDGO-001 v3.0 section 8 Gate-7 (Runtime Enforcement) production-consumption slice frozen by .1R.13.1 (sections 4/6/7/8/9/10/13/24) and its section 22 V-13-1 disposition. One production file changed: src/pcae/core/runtime_dispatch_gate7.py (new; git diff --name-only 698fabd9 HEAD -- src/pcae is exactly that one file). run_gate7_runtime_enforcement(gate6_decision, *, gate5_result, identity, inputs, authority_current_time) is the frozen SOLE production owner of the RDGO-001 section 8 Gate-7 runtime-enforcement consumption boundary for runtime_dispatch. It (1) consumes a registry-provenanced Gate6Decision ONLY via runtime_dispatch_permission.is_gate6_decision -- a forged / object.__new__ / field-reconstructed / copied / deepcopy / serialized / bare decision='ALLOW' lookalike and None all return (None, ('gate7_untrusted_gate6_decision',)) and create no Gate7Result; (2) enforces the frozen Gate-6 decision semantics -- decision != 'ALLOW' (by exact string equality) is a hard stop BEFORE any runtime-enforcement evaluation, returning (None, ('gate7_pb_decision_not_allow:DENY',)) / (None, ('gate7_pb_decision_not_allow:HUMAN_REVIEW',)) / (None, ('gate7_pb_decision_not_allow:<value>',)) with no Gate7Result -- no code path converts HUMAN_REVIEW or DENY into a positive result (anti-escalation invariant), so a POL-005 hard DENY never reaches a successful Gate-7 path; (3) consumes a registry-provenanced Gate5Result via runtime_dispatch_gate5.is_gate5_result and re-trusts + revalidates its ValidatedAuthorityProjection at Gate 7's own point of use (is_trusted_validated_authority_projection + revalidate_validated_authority_projection, which re-runs validate_approval and therefore re-resolves credential/proof/approval/expiry/consumption state and PB policy_version drift -- a projection revoked/expired/policy-drifted after Gate 5/6 fails closed as gate7_stale_validated_authority_projection); (4) preserves the exact invocation lineage (invocation_id and attempt_id equal across Gate5Result / Gate6Decision / identity -> gate7_invocation_binding_mismatch) and recomputes the subject_scope_binding_digest from identity + inputs via the shared runtime_dispatch_permission._expected_subject_scope_binding_digest (mismatch -> gate7_authority_subject_scope_mismatch); (5) re-checks the fourteen construction facts structurally via _validate_construction_inputs (drift -> gate7_request_currentness_drift:<detail>) and the local-CLI-v1 target/effect-class representability (ineligible -> gate7_runtime_target_ineligible); (6) INDEPENDENTLY evaluates the current fail-closed runtime posture -- resolve_runtime_enforcement_posture() reads one coherent snapshot from pcae.core.runtime_introspection (get_health/get_governance/get_state, EXECUTION_AVAILABILITY, CURRENT_RUNTIME_STATE, CURRENT_MAXIMUM_PLUGIN_CAPABILITY) plus the design-only runtime_enforcement_safety_authorization DEFAULT_AUTHORIZATION_FLAGS (all 12 False) / DEFAULT_SAFETY_FLAGS (all 5 True), and maps the snapshot to the blocking RE-NOGO set via the CONSUMED (never re-defined) AUTH_FLAG_TO_NO_GO / SAFETY_FLAG_TO_NO_GO tables -- there is NO caller parameter that carries posture and NO execution_available request field (AST param-set test asserts the exact kw-only set {gate6_decision, gate5_result, identity, inputs, authority_current_time}). Under the current Observed / observe / unavailable posture the matched set is a superset of {RE-NOGO-001, RE-NOGO-002, RE-NOGO-003..008, RE-NOGO-010, RE-NOGO-011}, so Gate 7 ALWAYS returns Gate7Result(decision='DENY', matched_no_go_ids=(...), causing_reason_ids=('gate7_runtime_execution_unavailable', 'gate7_safety_no_go:RE-NOGO-...', ...)) with reasons ('gate7_runtime_execution_unavailable',). RE-NOGO-002 (execution_boundary_absent) is the decisive Gate-7-owned capability no-go and is NOT inferred from POL-005 or the target name. NO legitimate positive production Gate-7 success is possible today -- two independent reasons, either sufficient: (a) the real Gate-6 call returns DENY (POL-005) -- actually (None, ...) because the permanent NON-REAL upstream means run_gate5 never returns a Gate5Result so run_gate6_permission_broker never returns a Gate6Decision -- so Gate 7 short-circuits before its own evaluation; (b) even given a hypothetical trusted Gate-6 ALLOW, the current posture matches multiple blocking RE-NOGO ids. The positive branch (decision='ALLOW') is present for structural completeness and marked pragma: no cover -- unreachable in production. Gate7Result is ephemeral, identity-only (__eq__ is self is other, __hash__ is id(self)), non-serializable (__reduce__ raises), not subclassable (__init_subclass__ raises), _seal-guarded, and registry-provenanced (is_gate7_result = exact-object membership in the process-local _GATE7_RESULTS set whose only insertion point is run_gate7_runtime_enforcement's completed-evaluation return path -- never isinstance / fields / equality / object.__new__ / copy / deepcopy / duck-type); decision in {ALLOW, DENY} only (no HUMAN_REVIEW at Gate 7); carries matched_no_go_ids / causing_reason_ids / invocation_id / attempt_id / request_id / pb_decision_digest / authority_freshness_digest / evaluated_input_digest / runtime_posture_digest / expires_at / evaluated_at; it is NOT an execution token (RDGO-001 section 0 wall Runtime Enforcement ALLOW != process permission) and a negative Gate7Result is a structured audit record, never partial success. Expiry is context/lifecycle-based, not wall-clock (invalid the moment any bound input / pb_decision_digest / authority_freshness_digest / runtime_posture_digest changes); expires_at is set to the evaluation instant; 'single-attempt' is enforced structurally (registry membership + bound digests), with NO durable 'attempt consumed' state, so Gate 7 stays idempotently repeatable (attempt 1 -> DENY, attempt 2 -> DENY, identical evaluated_input_digest, distinct objects, zero state mutation, zero consumption.json). Gate 7 CONSUMES NOTHING: no approval / HPAC proof / presentation / challenge / nonce / Gate5Result / Gate6Decision / authority record / lifecycle record is created, deleted, or mutated; no consumption.json is written; no runtime_invocation_authority_consumption primitive is called; both re-resolutions are reads. The whole body is wrapped in try/except Exception -> (None, ('gate7_internal_error_fail_closed',)) with no partial output. NO Gate-8 call (no runtime_dispatch_gate8 / shell_gate / build_shell_gate symbol), NO Gate-9 consumption (no runtime_invocation_authority_consumption import; no dispatch_attempted; 0 consumption.json created repo-wide), NO Gate-10 effect (AST forbidden-import guard: no subprocess / socket / requests / httpx / urllib / http / asyncio / multiprocessing / ctypes / pty / fcntl / signal / ssl / selectors; no .dispatch( / Popen( / os.system(; no adapter import). runtime_introspection.py, permission_broker_foundation.py (POL-005), runtime_dispatch_gate5.py, runtime_dispatch_permission.py, runtime_enforcement_safety_authorization.py, policy.py and all normative contracts (RDGO-001 v3.0, PBRD-001 v2.0, RPAC-001 v1.0, RIHAC-001 v2.0, RIASC-001 v3.0, HPAC-001 v2.0, PBPA-001, POL-005) are byte-unchanged since the phase-entry baseline 698fabd9 (git diff docs/contracts empty).
